title: Site comparison preserves inverse cartesian open base change
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $p:W\to T$ any scheme morphism and $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ an open immersion. Put $P=W\times_T S$, $b:P\to W$ and $q:P\to S$. Let $A$ be the etale/proetale inverse-image comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], let $a_f:A_{dom(f)}G_f^e\cong G_f^p A_{cod(f)}$ be the inverse of the specified pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], and let $o_j:A_{cod(j)}J_j^e\cong J_j^p A_{dom(j)}$ be the canonical open comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Take $\beta^e:G_p^eJ_i^e\cong J_b^eG_q^e$ and $\beta^p:G_p^pJ_i^p\cong J_b^pG_q^p$ to be the inverse canonical open-unit base-change maps [cor-cbc-derived-extension-zero-base-change, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]. For every etale sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $S$, $J_b^p(a_{q,F})\circ o_{b,G_q^eF}\circ A_W(\beta^e_F)=\beta^p_{A_SF}\circ G_p^p(o_{i,F})\circ a_{p,J_i^eF}$. This is an equality on ordinary sheaves; $p$ need not be proper.

proof.text: For arbitrary commutative coefficients, prove the unit normalization of the specified open comparison by the common-right-adjoint construction of Tag 09AF. Conjugate the restriction comparison: the two localization comparisons have identity conjugates, and the remaining conjugate is the canonical direct-image comparison. Evaluate the mate of the sectionwise restriction identity on sections; the pullback lift followed by its projection is the identity. The iterated-mate identity and injectivity identify the open-adjunction mate of the inverse extension comparison with the specified inverse-image comparison. Its mate unit equation, transported from restriction to upperStar, gives comparison_open_inverse_unit. This reproves the normalization for arbitrary coefficients rather than imposing the finite-ring hypothesis of the existing wrapper.

Flip the chosen cartesian square and apply comparison_square_component_of_commRing to it. Identify the coefficient comparisons with the inverses of comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso by their definitions. Identify the etale and pro-etale square maps with squareUpperStarIso and upperStarCompIso through the equal composite morphisms. Unpacking the component equation proves the required inverse-image square compatibility for arbitrary coefficients.

The pro-etale forward open-base-change map is the composite-adjunction conjugate of the canonical weakly etale base-change map. Its latter map is the pullback-adjunction mate of the inverse-image square. The conjugation unit identity and mate unit identity therefore give pro_open_unit. The etale forward map has the corresponding recorded open-unit normalization. Apply the generic exchange_comparison calculation: take inverses of the two compared composites, transpose under extension by zero along the upper open immersion, use the unit equations just proved, and use the square compatibility from the preceding step. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence identifies the composites.

Apply this comparison to the canonical pullback square for p and i. Postcompose by extension by zero of the inverse pullback-comparison component at q, and cancel the pullback-comparison component at p. Functoriality, associativity and the inverse-isomorphism identities give precisely the stated inverse-beta equation. No condition on p, no coefficient finiteness, and no nonemptiness condition has entered any step.

theorem finiteClopenBetaSiteTransport
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {W S T : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ T) (p : W ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) W).map
        ((@asIso _ _ _ _ _ (Etale.isIso_openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback p i).flip)).inv.app F) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
        (pullback.fst p i)).hom.app
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.snd p i)).obj F) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.fst p i)).map
        ((comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (pullback.snd p i)).inv.app F) =
    (comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).inv.app
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).obj F) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).hom.app F) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback p i).flip).inv.app
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) S).obj F)
